items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: And then I'm always coming back to that date which I think is one of the great unsung dates, with Brew Moore and J.J. Johnson... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. Well, I've got that album here, where I was playing with...

ctx.x: Well, with Jug it was such a groove...I mean, to be able to get into another groove, you know. But I enjoyed making the date with Jug.

And then I'm always coming back to that date which I think is one of the great unsung dates, with Brew Moore and J.J. Johnson, because there you're playing very harmonically, intricate, very beautiful things...
Yeah. Well, I've got that album here, where I was playing with... The Savoy thing you're taking about, right?
